children.counts: 4-count repeating pattern: Stomp right (1), Stomp left (2), Clap (3), Clap (4).
children.game_version: Call-and-response clapping game where kids echo the leader's rhythmic body-strikes and vocal chants.

seniors.counts: Simple 4-count rhythm: Stomp (1), Clap (2), Slap thigh (3), Pause (4).
seniors.seated_version: Perform hand claps, chest pats, and alternating seated foot stomps on a firm chair.
seniors.standing_version: Execute claps, thigh slaps, and gentle floor taps while holding a secure rail or chair back for balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to moderate speed and limit knee lift height during foot stomps.

learning_units.description: Basic body percussion sequence combining footsteps, claps, and thigh slaps.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Linear rows, grids, or circles executed in tight close-order military formations.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Engaged core with dynamic chest pops and torso slaps creating secondary rhythms.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Incorporate low grounded stomps, mid-level torso strikes, high gymnastic stunts, and signature leaps such as the Q Hop.
movement_profile.partnering: Synchronized line work with call-and-response interactions between line leaders and group members.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, grounded, athletic stance resembling military close-order drill posture.
